title: Manipulator
description: This is where the core logic of the rule is defined.

from.title: From
from.description: Defines the input conditions that trigger a manipulation.

to.title: To
to.description: Defines the action to take when the input conditions are met.

to_if_alone.title: To If Alone
to_if_alone.description: Defines the action to take if the key is pressed alone.

to_after_key_up.title: To After Key Up
to_after_key_up.description: Defines the action to take after the key is released.

to_if_held_down.title: To If Held Down
to_if_held_down.description: Defines the action to take if the key is held down.

to_delayed_action.title: To Delayed Action
to_delayed_action.description: Events which are sent after 500 milliseconds at you press from key

to_if_invoked.title: To If Invoked
to_if_invoked.description: Defines the action to take if the key is invoked.

to_if_canceled.title: To If Canceled
to_if_canceled.description: Defines the action to take if the key is canceled.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Defines the conditions that must be met for the rule to apply.
